output.title: Active members with no class in 30 days
output.sql: select display_name, programs, last_attended_on from v_members where status = 'active' and (last_attended_on is null or last_attended_on < current_date - 30) order by last_attended_on nulls first, display_name
output.explanation: Active members whose last check-in was more than 30 days ago (or who never checked in).
